subject: problem using cairo device on Win7 x64

messages.author: 483cd9333751ded0
messages.subject: problem using cairo device on Win7 x64
parts:
I have Rattle version 2.6.17 (same problem with 2.6.16) installed on a
Windows 7 x64 system with R-2.14.1.  For the most part Rattle runs
fine.  However, if I load the iris dataset and select the Explore tab
and try to get the boxplot of the distributions for sepal and petal
measurements using the cairoDevice, I only get the complete plot for
the first attribute (ie, sepal length).  For the others, I get the
plot frames and labels and the 'star' for the means, but no boxplots.
I can use the use the non-cairo graphics just fine (so far), so it is
not a major problem. Any suggestions on what the problem might be?  My
rattleInfo() is pasted below if that helps.

Thanks,

Dan

Daniel Nordlund
Bothell, WA USA
